answer: Propagate losses to the neighborhood. When the ledger proves an identity fraudulent, the penalty does not stop at the fake wallet — it travels along its attestation edges and burns a fraction of what its neighbors earned, too. Every agent therefore carries real risk in who it vouches for, and honest networks learn to prune contacts that look like a farm. The kernel of the rule is simple: shared exposure turns policing into self-interest. Honest work reads like a sonnet, distinct and hand-made; sybil clusters freeze into basalt, and the crack, once found, runs through the whole block.
